title: Qingfeng pipeline task manifest
description: Frozen approved task manifest embedded in an Issue body as a single ```json fenced block. Any edit invalidates the digest and stops the run.

repository.description: owner/name; must equal the configured repository.

issueNumber.description: Must equal the Issue number that carries this block.

approvedBy.description: Must be in the local approvedUsers allowlist.

baseRef.description: Shared branch is refused; must equal the configured baseRef.

baseSha.description: Full commit sha that must exist on baseRef.

branch.description: The only branch the pipeline may publish.

allowedPaths.description: Repository-relative directory prefixes the diff may touch, each ending with /.

verificationCommands.description: Must match the local command allowlist exactly; shell, eval and escaping are refused.

command.description: Preinstalled command name on this machine (for example node).

maxFixRetries.description: Fixed by policy: first attempt plus at most two fixes.
